We connect candidates with the most attractive employers in Romania. Below you can find a selection of jobs from top companies in Romania.
What are we looking for Were looking for a senior full-stack engineer with real depth in both frontend and backend, and a solid grip on data, infrastructure, and production. Youll work closely with our architect and our engineering manager, who also acts as Scrum Master and Product Owner. Together, we work directly with stakeholders from other teams, departments, and entities, so youll be in the room when decisions get made. This is a senior role. We need someone who has already done this work, not someone growing into it. What youll be doing Building and shipping features across the whole stack, from the database to the UI Shaping the architecture with our architect, and improving data processing and automation Working with stakeholders to understand what they need, estimate the work, and flag problems early Owning the quality of what you ship, including how it runs in production Growing through a personal development plan, courses, and conferences What youll need to know/have Youve owned complex systems end to end in enterprise environments, and other engineers come to you when things get hard Strong backend skills in Java (Spring Boot) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic) Serious frontend skills in JavaScript, HTML, and Vue.js. Strong React or Angular works too. Vue is quick to pick up. Solid database skills, relational and NoSQL. Depending on the project, we use PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis. System design that holds up in production: scalability, security, and observability Comfortable with cloud, Docker, and CI/CD Experience explaining technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders, and pushing back clearly and respectfully when something wont work Fluent English. French is a plus. What about AI? Part of our work is AI: agentic workflows, RAG, agentic RAG, and knowledge graphs. We build them with Pydantic AI, Spring AI, LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents. You should know how these systems work. You dont need to be fluent in them yet. If youve already built them, even better.Whats in it for you:  Performance Bonuses - based on your results & the companys;  Electronic Meal Tickets   Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too;  #WFH & Flexible hours;  Professional GSM subscription;  Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!];  Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services;  Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring;  Wellbeing Programs - we support your Zen;  Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.  Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.     At Orange, you can.  IMPORTANT  In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered.  We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
